title: Set umask for current session
summary: Change the umask value for the current shell session. This affects the default permissions of files and directories created from now on in this terminal window. The change is temporary and resets when you close the terminal.

steps.explain: Set the umask using octal notation. For example, '077' restricts all permissions for group and others, allowing only the owner full access.

placeholders.name: OCTAL_VALUE
placeholders.description: The new umask value in octal notation (e.g., 022, 077, 007).

alternatives.explain: Set the umask using symbolic notation. For example, 'a+r' adds read permission for all users to the current mask.

placeholders.name: SYMBOLIC_VALUE
placeholders.description: The new umask value in symbolic notation (e.g., a+r, u+rw, o-rwx).
